entities.name: Shattered States Era

events.summary: A warlord prayed to become Emperor of Kamigawa and the Myojin of Grim Betrayal granted him unmatched battle prowess, while granting the same boon to others.
events.quote: The Myojin of Grim Betrayal answered his prayer, granting him unmatched battle prowess
